newsitem.title: UK: EU warns E.Europe laggards not to scare investors.
newsitem.headline: EU warns E.Europe laggards not to scare investors.

text.p: The European Union warned central and eastern European countries which have failed to embrace economic reform that they would deter both aid and investment from abroad.
The warning was delivered by Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm, speaking on behalf of the EU, at the annual meeting of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) on Monday.
He said countries that had hardly embarked on systematic reform had the most difficulties. Without mentioning any by name, he urged such countries to take prompt and vigorous action.
"At this point, it is especially vital for these countries to send unambiguous signals to the rest of the world that they are pressing ahead firmly with reforms," Zalm said.
"Further delay will lead both investors and donors to flee rather than flock to these countries."
The "laggards" on the road to economic reform include Belarus, Russia's impoverished western neighbour, and, until recently, Bulgaria.
